bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears bounced back from their Week 5 loss by defeating the Atlanta Falcons 31-23 on Sunday, improving to 4-2 on the season. After missing three games with a hamstring injury, quarterback Caleb Williams made a triumphant return Sunday in Atlanta, leading the Bears to a 31-23 win over the Falcons at Mercedes-Benz Stadium.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions placed three players on injured reserve as the team heads into their Week 7 matchup against the Green Bay Packers at Ford Field, where they enter as small betting favorites in their first division game of the 2026 season. Detroit Lions have multiple open spots on the 53-man active roster.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers activated wide receiver Savion Williams off injured reserve ahead of their Week 6 matchup, as part of a series of roster moves announced on October 17. Meanwhile, running back Josh Jacobs is set to get a full week of practice with his game status still to be determined, while edge rusher Micah Parsons remains sidelined and has not yet returned to the field.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Vikings story of the last 24 hours centers on running back Jordan Mason, who has been designated to return from injured reserve on Monday after recovering from a thumb injury , giving the 5-0 team a timely boost at a position that had become a major concern. This news comes as Minnesota, sitting atop the NFC, is also reportedly poised to be aggressive at the trade deadline as the Colts face a potential fire sale ahead of their Week 7 matchup against Indianapolis.
